# webmcp-go

> Serve WebMCP tools (navigator.modelContext) from a Go net/http server.
> Declare tools with typed input schemas and handlers in Go; the package
> serves the registration script and the invoke endpoint. Stdlib only.

## Usage

- mux := webmcp.NewMux(); mux.Register(webmcp.Tool{Name, Description, InputSchema, Handler}).
- Schemas: webmcp.ObjectSchema(webmcp.String("field", "doc").Req(), ...) builds typed JSON Schema in Go.
- Mount: http.Handle("/.well-known/webmcp/", mux.ServeHTTP("/.well-known/webmcp")).
- Pages add one line: <script src="/.well-known/webmcp/register.js" defer></script>; agent calls POST to your Go handler.
- Compatibility: WebMCP is early (Chrome 149+ Origin Trial, Edge 150+, ChatGPT Desktop); see the README's honest status section.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ofershap/webmcp-go#readme): compatibility status, usage, what you get
